## WhatsApp eligibility (sends NOTHING)
Triages every phone contact into eligible / needs-approval / ineligible. A scraped number is NEVER assumed to have WhatsApp: it needs human approval (Lead detail page → Approve WhatsApp, or POST /api/data-quality/whatsapp/approve/{contact_id}) before the Approved Message Sender may use it. Opt-outs and suppressions are always ineligible.

Requires env LEADPILOT_API_URL.
